The parent component is re-rendering. When a parent renders, all its children render too by default, even if their props didn't change. The most common fixes: **Wrap the child with `memo`** — tells React to skip re-renders when props are shallow-equal. ```jsx const ChildComponent = memo(({ prop1, prop2 }) => { return
{prop1} {prop2}
}) ``` **But memo only works if the props are the same *references*.** If you're passing a new object or function each time, they fail the equality check: ```jsx // ❌ New object every render — memo won't help // ✓ Same reference every render — memo works const style = { color: 'red' } ``` For inline objects and functions, wrap them with `useMemo` and `useCallback`: ```jsx const style = useMemo(() => ({ color: 'red' }), []) const handleClick = useCallback(() => { /* ... */ }, []) ``` If the child consumes context, it re-renders when that context changes, regardless of props.
